text: Pour card for L5 deck on Harbor Point is signed. Tobin wants the slump test done before the first truck, so tell the pump company to hold until 6. Also, the rebar inspector moved to 1pm.
Morning crew, RFI 114 on the shear wall embeds is still open. Renata says she will answer by end of day. Do not set the sleeves until we have her response in writing.
Kofi, your electricians left conduit stubs on the east stair without caps. Pull them or cap them before the drywall guys get in there tomorrow. Send me a photo when it is done.
Thanks for covering the gate yesterday. I owe you a coffee. Let me know if you want the Saturday shift and I will put you on the schedule.
Gianni, the scaffold tag on the north side of Eastgate is green but the toe board is missing on level 2. Fix that today and I need the inspection log updated by Friday.
Lupe, can you send me the signed daily log for Monday? The owner rep asked for it and I forgot to pull it from the box before I left.
Shoring plan for the P2 deck came back with two comments from the engineer. Marisol is sending the revised drawing this afternoon. We cannot strip forms until she signs off on it.
Quick one, is the hot work permit for the welding on the roof still good? The fire watch needs a name and I don't have one on the sheet.
Hollis said the lift is booked for 7 to 10 on Thursday. Crane tailswing zone is taped off on the east side so nobody walks under it. Toolbox talk at 6:45 covers the lift plan.
Dewatering pump on Lakeside is cycling too much again. Check the float switch and make sure the discharge hose is not kinked at the curb. I don't want another flood in the excavation.
Good work on the punch list at Lakeside. We closed 41 items today which is more than I expected. Let's keep the same crew on the nurse station floor next week.
Tobin, the rebar cage at gridline C-4 is short two bars in the top mat. Pull the ties, add the bars, then call the special inspector before you tie the rest.
Please do not pour in the rain without the cover tarps on the pump hose and the deck. Last time we lost a whole truck of mix and the owner was not happy about it.
Renata, the 3-week lookahead is updated. The drywall start on Lakeside slipped two days because the mud crew is out, so I moved the paint back and the float is now gone.
The submittal for the fire-rated door frames came back as revise and resubmit. Marisol says the hardware schedule is wrong. Send the corrected cut sheet to the architect today.
Lunch is on the corner of Fifth. Gianni already ordered the sandwiches so pick up yours by noon or they will go to the apprentices. See you at the gang box.
Dwayne, I need the T-and-B report before the owner walkthrough on Thursday. Test and balance is saying the supply air on level 3 is 20 percent under design, so they need to rebalance.
Sleeve layout for the mechanical room looks off by about four inches from the grid. I flagged it on the coordination model. Do not core anything until the plumbing sub confirms.
Hollis, the knuckle boom is leaking hydraulic fluid again near the outrigger. Tag it out and call the rental company. I am not letting it near the steel until someone looks at it.
Quick note from the owner rep, she wants the photo log uploaded by Monday. Just drop the folder in the shared drive and I'll take care of the rest. Thanks all.
Harbor Point L6 deck pour is set for Wednesday. The concrete sub wants the cure blankets staged on the roof the day before so we are not chasing them in the wind.
Marisol, the engineer approved the revised shoring. Tell the shoring crew they can start setting posts on L5 but no stripping until the cylinders break at seven days.
Cylinder results came back at 3,850 psi, which clears the strip criteria. Tobin says the forms on the east bay can come out Monday. Keep the reshores in until I see the engineer's letter.
Kofi, the temporary power panel on Eastgate tripped twice this morning. Somebody had a bump heater on the same circuit as the mud mixer. Move the heater and label the breaker.
Can you check whether the elevator pit on Harbor Point has water in it? The sump alarm went off on the overnight report and I want eyes on it before the inspector comes in.
Thanks for the quick turnaround on the RFI. Renata said the architect is fine with the substitution for the embed plate, so we can move ahead without a change order.
Gianni, the fall protection plan needs the new anchor points on the L6 edge. Get the rigger out there with the certs before the steel guys start on the west side.
The owner asked whether we can pull the CO on the Lakeside lobby ceiling, the one with the soffit. Let's price it out and send it to Renata before end of day so she can look.
Lupe, your crew left the gang box unlocked over the weekend and a grinder went missing. Please lock it every night and log anything you take out. I cannot keep explaining losses to accounting.
Pump truck is coming at 5:30 tomorrow, the batch plant confirmed. We need the hose line run from the pump to L6 before anybody else gets on the deck, so start early.
Eastgate P2 has a float problem. If the decking goes late we lose the paving window, so push the topping crew to Tuesday and move the stair pours to the week after.
Hollis, I need the tower crane lift plan signed by the engineer before Thursday. The steel delivery is 14 pieces and two of them are over 9,000 pounds, so we cannot wing it.
Did anyone see where the Lakeside dentist's cell phone went? It was on the lunch table yesterday and I think the lady from the owner's office grabbed it by mistake. Let me know.
Dwayne, the moisture readings on the L4 slab are still high. The flooring guys want under 75 percent RH. I will ask Tobin to run more readings before we chase them on the schedule.
Please stop using the south stair as a material drop. It is the only egress we have on that side and the fire marshal already wrote us up once this month for it.
Good call moving the drywall to the north side first. The lift is cleaner and the hangers are on time. Keep the mud crew on the same shifts so the finish quality stays consistent.
Renata, the change order for the extra hold-down anchors came back approved. The owner says we can add them in the next pour without a delay. Send Marisol the revised detail.
Lunch was great today. Thanks to whoever brought the brisket. We will do the same on Friday if the rain holds off so we can eat outside near the site trailer.
Kofi, the low-voltage cable tray on the L6 corridor is sagging between hangers at grid 7 and 8. Add a support or pull the tray and reinstall before the ceiling crew closes it up.
Can you grab me a coffee on your way back from the supply house? Black with one sugar is fine. Thanks for doing that, I am stuck in this meeting until two.
Harbor Point L7 layout is marked. Hollis, the crane is moving to the new footing on Monday so the first lift on L7 will slip a day. Keep the steel crew on L6 for now.
Marisol, the sub for the stair stringers wants a new shop drawing approval before they cut the steel. Can you chase the architect again? I am tired of waiting on the same stamp.
Good morning. Heads up, the pour on Eastgate topping is pushed to Thursday because of rain, and I am not doing it in the wet. Crew knows, text them if you have questions.
Hey, are you still coming to the Eastgate crew barbecue on Saturday? Bring the kids if you want, the Harrisons said they will have the bouncy castle up again this year.
The owner rep called asking why the Lakeside closeout binder is late. I told her we are waiting on three O&M manuals from the mechanical sub. Please chase them today.
Thanks for helping me move the forms. My back is shot but we got the stacks down before dark. I am going to sleep for a day now.
Tobin, the cylinder breaks for the L6 pour came back under target at seven days. I need the cure log checked because the blankets were off overnight on the north end. Let's talk tomorrow.
Kofi, the arc fault breakers at the Lakeside clinic are nuisance tripping on the exam room circuits. Check if it is the device loads or the cable run before we call the manufacturer.
Dwayne, we have a near miss on Eastgate. A piece of rebar slid off the stack and missed a laborer by a foot. I want a safety stand-down before anybody touches that stack again.
Gianni, write up the near miss and get the photos into the incident folder. Also add it to the agenda for Friday toolbox talk so the whole crew hears it from you, not me.
What time is the owner walk on Lakeside? I want the fire alarm devices tested and the access panels labeled before they come through, so tell the low voltage guys to clear the corridor.
Renata, I need a decision on the wall tile substitution by Wednesday. The supplier has the back order and the install schedule is going to slip if we keep waiting.
Marisol, put the new shop drawings for the mezzanine stair in the RFI log under 140. Keep the old revision in the superseded folder so we don't mix them up again.
Hollis, the forklift battery at the laydown yard is dead again. Bring the charger from the trailer and leave a note on the door so the next guy knows what is going on.
The concrete sub asked for a rain day credit on Eastgate. I told them to submit the weather log with their daily reports. No credit without the log, that is the rule on this job.
Lunch Friday is on me since we finished the L6 deck early. Pick whatever you want from the taco truck, just be back at the gang box by 12:30 so we can make the safety brief.
Harbor Point elevator guides are out of plumb on the lower two floors. Call the installer and tell them to check the anchor spacing before they set the rail brackets any higher.
Lupe, the water heater in the site trailer is leaking under the sink again. Shut the valve and put a bucket under it until the plumber shows up on Monday. Don't let the electrical panel get wet.
Final walk on the Lakeside annex is set for Thursday at 10. Make sure the punch list items are green in the tracker and the rooms are swept, the owner is picky about dust on the windows.
Thanks everyone for a solid three weeks. Dwayne is taking over the Eastgate closeout next, and I will be on Harbor Point full time. Call me if anything breaks overnight.
